title: GTA 6 Release Date: Xbox Reportedly Warns on NZ Trick
description: The GTA 6 release date New Zealand trick lets Xbox players unlock early, but Microsoft reportedly warned journalists against it. Here is what we know.

body.text: The GTA 6 release date is now close enough that players are hunting for ways to start early, and Xbox fans have a popular one: switching their console region to New Zealand. According to Notebookcheck, Microsoft allegedly warned journalists against using this trick as launch approached. It matters because the shortcut is widely used, and the reports suggest Rockstar is watching for early access more closely than usual.
How the GTA 6 release date trick works
Notebookcheck says the idea is to become a temporary New Zealander so the game unlocks sooner. On Xbox, changing region is done in console settings.
On PlayStation 5 it is harder. Players need to open a New Zealand-based PSN account and then buy the game using a local gift card.

The official launch for both Xbox and PS5 versions is midnight local time on November 19th, per the report. Without the workaround, players on the US West Coast would wait an extra 21 hours, which explains the appeal of the trick.
What Microsoft and Rockstar reportedly said

Region switching technically breaks Microsoft's terms of service. The quoted wording says that attempting to circumvent restrictions can affect customer privacy and the integrity of Microsoft or partner services. The guidelines say account holders should change region settings only after moving to another country.
These warnings are secondhand and unconfirmed by Microsoft. The reports come from several people:

items: Windows Central's Jennifer Young claims Rockstar is treating the launch like a "military operation" and is monitoring unauthorized early access more than usual.
Windows Central's Jez Corden says a company representative echoed those comments at the recent Xbox FanFest.
Content creator Colt Eastwood reports that a "kinda popular Xbox employee" pointed out the risks of the trick.

body.text: Notebookcheck's view is that, going by history, bans or account restrictions will be rare or non-existent. Countless people have used the shortcut to play games ahead of schedule. It is still a risk, and each player has to decide whether the early start is worth a small chance of punishment.

Streamers may face more heat. German-based creator Rohat said a Twitch partner manager advised against showing gameplay that was unlocked through the trick. For anyone planning to stream launch day, that is worth taking seriously.

Next, watch whether Microsoft or Rockstar confirm any enforcement, and whether any accounts are actually flagged once the game unlocks. The source does not say how the timing works for players in India, so check the official launch details from Rockstar and your platform before planning a midnight session.

faqs.a: According to Notebookcheck, players change their console region to New Zealand so the game unlocks earlier. On Xbox this is done in console settings, while PS5 players need a New Zealand-based PSN account and a local gift card.

faqs.q: When is the GTA 6 release date on Xbox and PS5?
faqs.a: Notebookcheck reports the Xbox and PS5 versions officially go live at midnight local time on November 19th. Without the workaround, US West Coast players would wait an additional 21 hours.

faqs.q: Can you get banned for using the GTA 6 region trick?
faqs.a: Region switching technically violates Microsoft's terms of service, but Notebookcheck says bans or account restrictions are likely to be rare or non-existent based on past precedent. Streamers may face more scrutiny, as one Twitch partner manager reportedly advised against showing gameplay unlocked this way.
